_comment: Per-app menu manifest for the 1Password viewer. Porthole inserts these menus between the default Edit and Window menus. Each item: title, optional 'key'(+shift/alt) for a Mac Cmd-shortcut, and 'send' = a forwarded combo (ctrl+shift+l) or a native @action. Items without a 'key' are click-only (Lock/Quick Access already ride the global hotkeys).
